articles.summary: BOSTON, May 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- X4 Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: XFOR), a company focused on improving the lives of people with rare hematology diseases, today announced that management will present at the 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference on Thursday, June 4, 2026 at 3:45 p.m. ET.
